text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Tous les prestataires de services des États membres de l'UE/AELE doivent en outre annoncer les jours exacts de travail sur le portail www.easygov.swiss avant de commencer leur activité en Suisse.", "gist": "EU/AELE service providers must announce exact workdays on www.easygov.swiss before starting work in Switzerland."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "www.easygov.swiss", "gist": "Swiss government online portal for short-term work notifications"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Secrétariat d'État aux migrations SEM", "gist": "Swiss State Secretariat for Migration (SEM)"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "La confirmation de l’annonce est une condition préalable obligatoire à l'entrée en Suisse.", "gist": "Confirmation of the announcement is a mandatory prerequisite for entering Switzerland."}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Documentation", "gist": "Documentation section label"}]}
